decisionDependencies.role: One host-owned total termination mapper and one process-boundary exit write site.
v1.2 must provide schema-complete payloads, prohibited-effect assertions, executable mapper goldens, and traceable back-references.
The prior review explicitly required a JSON Schema and executable derivation fixtures rather than class/code examples.
Unsupported recipes produce no comparison and no comparison-derived findings.
Finalization is linearized and post-commit signals cannot race a settled outcome.

conformanceClaims.claim: The review mechanically checks schema presence, union payloads, class/code mapping, duplicate IDs, and executable scenario inputs.
The unsupported-recipe case is checked for the prohibited effects, not only termination class.
The finalization concept and the machine-testability of its cases are reviewed separately.

mechanicalValidation.verdict: v1.2 repairs v1.1's twelve missing required payloads and class/code consistency remains sound. It still is not the schema-validated executable mapper contract required by 07 and the A2 v1.1 review.

accepted.claim: baseline-compare-unsupported-recipe now asserts comparisonPerformed=false, comparisonDerivedFindingCount=0, and repair actions.
A finalization commit point and post-commit signal classification are the correct semantic model.
IDENTITY.EXPIRED requires tombstone evidence; otherwise the resolver must return an unknown classification.
Cooperative serve stop is success and latest on an empty single-identity resolver is request-rejected.
The six termination classes and numeric mapping are accepted unchanged.

findings.title: v1.2 still has no JSON Schema and its expected termination objects are not members of its declared union
findings.detail: hostTerminationUnion lists required/optional field names but no types, nullability, reason-code vocabulary, or unknown-field policy. Every expectedTermination also contains exitCode, which no union variant permits. If unknown fields are allowed the union is not closed; if they are forbidden all 38 fixtures are invalid. This is exactly why the v1.1 review required an actual schema.
findings.requiredFix: Provide a JSON Schema with a closed oneOf HostTermination union and typed fields. Separate expectedHostTermination from expectedExitCode, or explicitly define a distinct ExpectedProcessOutcome schema containing both. Validate the artifact in CI.

findings.title: There are no inputs from which deriveHostTermination can be tested
findings.detail: mapperTestInterface says each golden constructs scenarioAxes and asserts derive(scenarioAxes), but none of the 38 golden cases contains scenarioAxes or another machine-readable input. Case IDs and free-text rules cannot drive a mapper. The fixtures can test class-to-code lookup only, which 07 explicitly says is insufficient.
findings.requiredFix: Define a closed ScenarioAxes/input union per command kind and include one input object in every golden. Express precedence as a machine-readable decision table or executable reference mapper; assert derive(input) deep-equals expectedHostTermination, then map it to expectedExitCode.

findings.title: Finalization is semantically correct but not represented as a testable transition
findings.detail: The first analysis rule depends on finalizationCommitReached and HostTermination already settled, making the derivation function depend on its own prior output. The post-commit golden has only a prose note, not pre-state, signal event, settled termination, and expected post-state observables.
findings.requiredFix: Keep settlement in deriveHostTermination and model post-settlement signal handling as a separate state transition. Add machine fields such as preState, event, expectedState, expectedHostTerminationUnchanged, and transportShutdownRequested.

findings.title: Back-references are named but not resolvable and conformance evidence is partly self-description
findings.detail: decisionDependencies carry IDs and roles but no source paths. Several conformanceClaims cite collection/key prose such as goldenCases or all golden expectedTermination.exitCode rather than stable evidence IDs. A reviewer cannot mechanically detect a renamed or dropped source property.
findings.requiredFix: Use structured {id, source, scopedObligation} dependencies. Give validators/tests stable IDs and make every conformance claim reference only those IDs; reject dangling IDs.

findings.title: The expiry distinction remains a prose precondition rather than two executable cases
findings.detail: query-addressed-run-expired embeds a sentence saying otherwise emit IDENTITY.UNKNOWN, but there is no golden for no live record and no tombstone. An implementation could always emit EXPIRED and still pass all current fixtures.
findings.requiredFix: Add separate scenario inputs and goldens: absent live row plus retained tombstone -> IDENTITY.EXPIRED; absent live row plus no tombstone -> IDENTITY.UNKNOWN/appropriate request-rejected payload.

findings.title: Cases that exist to prove axis separation do not assert the separated axes
findings.detail: required-delivery-failed does not assert that the sealed Run verdict remains pass while termination is operational-failed; optional-cloud-egress-failed does not assert the local verdict/Run is unchanged; verification mutations do not assert retention of the mutation receipt. The class alone cannot prove invariant-verdict-vs-termination or the mutation rule.
findings.requiredFix: Add structured expectedEffects/domainOutcome fields for local verdict, sealed Run identity, comparison/egress diagnostics, and mutation receipt retention where those properties are the reason for the case.

findings.title: The interrupted fixture uses an ambiguous nullable placeholder
findings.detail: user-interrupt-finite supplies runId=$RUN_ID_OR_NULL while the pseudo-union only says runId is optional and defines no type or nullability. The fixture does not decide whether pre-admission interruption omits runId or includes null.
findings.requiredFix: With the JSON Schema, choose omission or explicit nullable semantics and add distinct pre-admission and post-admission interruption cases if both are supported.

requiredV13Changes: Add a real closed JSON Schema for HostTermination, ScenarioAxes, ExpectedEffects, and the golden-case record.
Separate HostTermination payload from expected numeric exit code.
Supply machine-readable input axes for every golden and an executable reference mapper or decision table.
Represent finalization signal handling as a state transition with observable assertions.
Split tombstone-present and tombstone-absent identity cases.
Add domain/effect assertions for verdict-versus-termination, optional egress, required delivery, and mutation receipts.
Replace prose dependency/evidence references with resolvable source and test IDs.
Run schema validation, required-field/unknown-field checks, derivation deep equality, class-to-code mapping, duplicate-ID checks, and dangling-reference checks.

agent2Disposition.next: Publish v1.3 and an executable validator/harness. Do not update 07 to call v1.2 binding until those checks pass.
